title: Suppliers and vendors
summary: Two different things with confusingly similar names, and what each is for.
html:
These are two separate features and the naming does not help, so take them one at a time.

Suppliers

A supplier is a customer record with the supplier type. It is the same record with different fields shown and its own place in the menu — so a company you both buy from and sell to is one record, not two.

Use suppliers for the companies you buy from. Products can record which supplier they come from, which makes a price change easy to trace through the catalogue. See Products.

Vendors

A vendor is a grouping. It gathers staff members or suppliers together under one heading, which is useful when you subcontract: a vendor can hold the several people who work for one subcontracting firm, and you can see everything assigned across them.

It is a light feature and plenty of installations never use it. If it is not useful to you, switch the plugin off in Settings → Plugins and the menu goes away.
